title: GrapeVine
tagline: GrapeVine: A chat app where friends can easily send messages and make ETH transactions. Say goodbye to address copying and welcome secure real-time crypto conversations.
description: GrapeVine is a place where you can interact and make transactions online by combining a chat application with a payment platform. Users can easily connect their wallets, authenticate using the Push protocol, and start chatting and making transactions with friends without having to copy and paste wallet addresses. The integration of GrapeVines with the Push protocol enables real-time messaging and transaction notification, providing a smooth and secure user experience. Regardless of whether you send crypto or request it, all actions are performed in a chat, providing a single platform for communication and transactions. GrapeVine aims to reduce the anxiety associated with sending cryptocurrencies and verifying transaction statuses by creating a transparent and user-friendly environment.
how_its_made: GrapeVine uses @pushprotocol to handle real-time messaging and transaction notifications. Our frontend is developed using next.js. The backend interacts with the Ethereum blockchain and the Push protocol, organizing the data flow between the blockchain, the Push protocol, and the frontend.
